name: Spot
mechanic: Full-range AMM with an oracle-set base + surge fee, reinvesting the protocol cut.
plain: A full-range AMM hook with a truncated geometric-mean oracle that adjusts LP fees (base plus surge) from tick movement, takes a protocol fee share on each swap and reinvests it into a full-range position.
rules: LP fees combine a base rate and an oracle-driven surge.
The protocol fee share reinvests into a full-range position.
